title: Truth of a quantified Boolean formula
statement: A quantified Boolean formula is true if its CNF matrix evaluates to true under the recursive quantification specified by its quantifier list, starting with the assignment that sets every natural-number variable to false and with starting index $0$.
hypotheses_covered: A quantified Boolean formula with a quantifier list and CNF matrix
